description: Valentine's Day: all of SERIFU/VALEN.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6v), 182 of 187 strings; the five '‥‥' pauses stay; plus VALEN.EXN's location banners (Hall, Class, Rear, Roof, Gate, Home). 13 sections from VALEN.EXN's tables at 0x801343F0 (tools/geko_sections.py --valen): 0 Yuko, 1 the player's count of the day, 2 Shiori, 3 Yuina, 4 Ijuin, 5 Ayako, 6 Mira, 7 Mio, 8 Yukari, 9 Nozomi, 10 Megumi (with Shiori introducing her, speaker code 0B), 11 Saki, 12 Yumi. Each girl gives courtesy (part 0) or heartfelt (part 1) chocolate. Verified in DuckStation on forced Valentine's Days (force_valen.py via xmas_run.ps1, hidden emulator): Ijuin's lines for all three years; every girl's heartfelt and courtesy scene except Shiori's heartfelt-after-apology variant 5; Megumi's introduction and Shiori's apology; two count thoughts; each day ends normally. Checked only statically: each girl's part 2 (a later scene the forced girl list doesn't reach), the other count thoughts, the banners (not visible behind the boxes), natural triggers.
